lfr.acceptance_rule: First valid attempt with abs(vol-weighted mean truth conductance-target)<=0.025; stop immediately. If 8 attempts fail tolerance, select valid graph with minimum absolute deviation (tie earliest attempt), label UNREACHED. If no valid graph, label GENERATION_FAILED and do not fabricate input.
lfr.calibration_rule: Start native mu at target. On valid out-of-tolerance graph use mu + target - observed, clipped [0.001,0.999]. If valid below/above observations bracket the target, use midpoint of their native mu values instead. Reuse identical generation seed for every attempt. On generation failure use target + offsets[attempt_index] where offsets for subsequent attempts are [+0.015,-0.015,+0.030,-0.030,+0.060,-0.060,+0.100], clipped [0.001,0.999].
lfr.query_rule: One global independent default_rng(20261003), selected cases ordered n then target then generation seed; choose 6 distinct truth communities uniformly (all if fewer), then 2 distinct uniform nodes per chosen community (all if fewer). Labels used only for query construction and offline evaluation.
lfr.structural_validity: Exactly n nodes; undirected simple graph; exactly one truth membership per node; no isolated nodes; graph finite and all truth communities nonempty. Record observed community bounds/degree bounds and warning rather than silently rewrite native output.
lfr.test_use: Freeze generated graph/truth/query hashes; no tuning and no algorithm-quality-based selection
lfr.truth_conductance: phi(C)=cut(C)/min(vol(C),M-vol(C)); weighted mean=sum_C vol(C)*phi(C)/M for a disjoint complete truth partition
